upstream.description: A personal agent with a browser, terminal, files, and work that keeps going built with CopilotKit and AG-UI.

classification.analysis: OpenMuse is an alpha personal-agent app from CopilotKit that gives an agent a persistent Chromium browser, an optional Linux terminal and files, with durable tasks that keep running and a takeover console for the user. It has a Hono API with task and browser workers, an Expo React Native client for iOS, Android and web, and CopilotKit/AG-UI streaming with inline email, PDF, plan and finance cards. Gmail/Calendar integration, PDF form filling and goal tracking are included, and the README invites cloning it as a template, with a Render blueprint for deployment.
